sloka: यदा भृशार्तैर्निनदैर्महात्मा न कुम्भकर्णो बुबुधे प्रसुप्तः ।ततो मुसुण्ठीर्मुसलानि सर्वे रक्षोगणास्ते जगृहुर्गदाश्च ।। ६.६०.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: yadā bhṛśārtairninadairmahātmā na kumbhakarṇo bubudhe prasuptaḥ ।tato musuṇṭhīrmusalāni sarve rakṣogaṇāste jagṛhurgadāśca ।। 6.60.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the excited Rakshasas could not wake up Kumbhakarna happily sleeping on the ground in spite of hitting with rocks and trees and their fists.
